intro:
Get ready to challenge your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills with 'Move to Gram' - a captivating puzzle game that's inspired by the timeless art of tangram. Developed by GamePix, 'Tangram Challenge' is a browser-based game that's designed to test your strategic thinking and visual creativity.

In this game, players are presented with a set of seven tangram pieces (five triangles, one square, and one parallelogram) that need to be rotated, dragged, and dropped into the correct positions to form a secret shape. The game features 24 exciting levels, each with a new and complex shape to solve, making it an ideal choice for fans of puzzle games and brain teasers.

The game's core premise is simple yet addictive, and it's this simplicity that makes it so appealing to players of all ages and skill levels. With its intuitive controls and immersive gameplay experience, 'Tangram Challenge' is a game that's sure to keep you engaged for hours on end.

Whether you're a seasoned puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a new challenge to tackle, 'Move to Gram' is a game that's definitely worth trying out. So, grab your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls and get ready to put your spatial reasoning skills to the test in this thrilling puzzle game!
